source: September feature and embedding exports; checked against current matched field observations.
features: Six bands R G B NIR RE DB; 5x5 means/std/ranges plus Lyzenga log-difference indices. Full-scene water statistics for unsupervised normalization. Clay native224x224, GSD1.2, scene-water normalization, geographic/week encodings and central token14 preserve the PNEO exploration conventions.
evaluation: Leave one depth-by-transect group out; train-only StandardScaler; LR C0.01 class_weight balanced; threshold0.5 fixed; every September quadrat evaluated once.
limitations: Exploratory same-scene evaluation on six adjacent transects; overlapping image windows and reused analysis. Not the final S2 models or independent geographic validation. Transect centring removes a shared offset, not all confounders. Multiple feature tests corrected with Benjamini-Hochberg separately per test family.
